prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one single “best” AI video ad maker — the right choice depends on what you need (social short ads vs. personalized at-scale vs. AI spokesperson vs. editing/repurposing). Below are the top options by use case, with quick pros/cons and a one-line recommendation.

Top picks by use case

- Best all-round / easiest for social ads: Canva
  - Pros: Massive template library, brand kit, easy drag‑and‑drop, good stock media, affordable, team collaboration.
  - Cons: Less “AI-generated” actor/voice automation; limited advanced video effects.

- Best for AI presenters / talking-head ads: Synthesia (also HeyGen, Colossyan as alternatives)
  - Pros: Realistic AI avatars in many languages, API, scripted-to-video quickly, brand control.
  - Cons: Costlier, less flexible for complex editing or visual effects.

- Best for turning long content into short ads: Pictory or Descript
  - Pros: Auto highlights, captions, clip extraction, easy edit & transcribe, fast repurposing.
  - Cons: Not ideal for creating animations or stylized templates from scratch.

- Best for high-volume personalized / dynamic ads at scale: Idomoo, SundaySky, Jivox (enterprise)
  - Pros: Personalized video at scale using feeds/CRM data, strong ad-platform integrations.
  - Cons: Enterprise pricing and onboarding.

- Best for advanced generative visuals / creative effects: Runway
  - Pros: Cutting‑edge generative video tools, background removal, inpainting/animation.
  - Cons: More of a creative toolset — steeper learning curve for ad production workflows.

- Best budget-friendly template-first makers: InVideo, Promo.com, Biteable
  - Pros: Lots of ad templates, stock footage, quick output, affordable plans.
  - Cons: Less AI automation, more manual template customization.

- Best for editing + AI voice cloning: Descript
  - Pros: Overdub voice cloning, transcript-based editing, multitrack timeline.
  - Cons: Not avatar-focused; better for spoken-word ads and podcast repurposing.

How to choose quickly
- Need fast social ads with brand templates → Canva or InVideo.
- Need a realistic on-screen presenter → Synthesia or HeyGen.
- Need to create dozens/hundreds of personalized videos → Idomoo/SundaySky.
- Need to repurpose webinars/podcasts into short ads → Pictory or Descript.
- Want cutting-edge generative visuals or special effects → Runway.

If you tell me:
- platform(s) (Facebook/Instagram/YouTube/TikTok),
- budget (free/cheap/enterprise),
- whether you need AI presenters or personalization,
I’ll recommend the single best tool and a simple workflow for your use case.
